description_en: Retrieves a list of upgrade items
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-upgrade-items --max-results 50 --next-token AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1130916744880000 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUpgradeItems

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Leave this parameter empty for the first request. To retrieve the next page, set this parameter to the NextToken value from the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management center is located. Select a region based on where your assets are. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the member's view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned on the current page
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量

NextToken.description_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. If the value is not empty, more results are available
NextToken.description_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值

UpgradeItemId.description_en: The ID of the upgrade item
